source_name: Hong Kong — Junctions with Red Light Camera System installed (TD)
attribution_text: Fonte: Hong Kong Transport Department via data.gov.hk — Junctions with Red Light Camera System installed (https://data.gov.hk/en-data/dataset/hk-td-tis_25-junctions-with-rlc), concesso con data.gov.hk Terms of Use.
notes: Coda giurisdizioni pass v2 (2026-08-21, catalogo OK): 232 giunzioni con sistema Red Light Camera. Il dataset NON ha coordinate: geocodificate via Nominatim (1 req/s, UA ufficiale OpenSurveillanceDB-import; script payloads/geocode-hk-rlc.py) e importate con payload JSONL. Giunzioni senza hit geocodifica SKIP con motivo documentato (fail-closed: nessuna coordinata inventata). external_id hk-rlc:<No.>. Aggiornato 'as and when major update'.
